summary: Round-1 minor is resolved and no regressions were introduced. The 4096-cap raw-vs-trimmed boundary was kept as-is (deliberate, safe-side over-strictness) and the comment at FunnelStepForm.vue:629-630 now documents the parity: backend requireKeyboardText validates text.length() on the received value with no independent trim/length-clobber, the frontend emits the trimmed text, so the only divergence is that a pathological 4096-visible-chars-plus-trailing-whitespace input is over-blocked client-side — it can never under-block and can never cause a 422. Verified directly against backend FunnelService.requireKeyboardText (lines 1276-1283: null/isBlank + length() > MAX_KEYBOARD_TEXT, no trim) and validateSetKeyboard/validateClearKeyboard (1220-1273): client validation still mirrors byte-for-byte — non-blank text, 1..10 rows, 1..4 buttons/row, button text non-blank and <=64, Set-based case-sensitive duplicate on trimmed texts, and CLEAR_KEYBOARD's symmetric strict rejection (emits only text+parseMode+id+next). The test-reviewer minors are all addressed correctly: 'renders no resize_keyboard control' now asserts exactly two checkboxes plus zero input[type=checkbox] inside step-keyboard-rows; a 'blocks submit on blank CLEAR_KEYBOARD text' case was added; and the SET render test pins exactly 1 row x 1 button (button-0-1 and button-1-0 asserted null), which the cap/add/remove tests' arithmetic depends on. All template data-test selectors match the spec selectors (button-error, duplicate-error, hint), per-button error and duplicate error are correctly gated on keyboardTouched, and the keyword hint stays advisory (never gates onSubmit). i18n is at full uk/en parity (17 identical keyboard* keys per locale plus matching type/summary entries). No blocking, major, or minor issues this round.
